0:
apk add --no-cache libc6-compat &&
wget -qO- https://github.com/nebhale/teslamate-discovery/releases/download/v2.6.0/teslamate-discovery_2.6.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz | tar xz -C /tmp &&
/tmp/teslamate-discovery \
  --mqtt-host mosquitto.default.svc.cluster.local \
  --mqtt-port 1883 \
  --mqtt-scheme tcp \
  --mqtt-username anonymous \
  --mqtt-password anonymous \
  --units-distance metric \
  --units-pressure metric

Masters,German Masters,Welsh Open,World Grand Prix,Players Championship,Tour Championship,World Championship,UK Championship,International Championship,Northern Ireland Open,Wuhan Open,Saudi Arabia Masters,Shanghai Masters,World Open,China Grand Prix

echo "Downloading static binaries..."

# Install wget if not present
apk add --no-cache wget

# Download static jq
echo "Downloading jq..."
wget -O /deps/jq https://github.com/jqlang/jq/releases/download/jq-1.7.1/jq-linux-amd64
chmod +x /deps/jq

# Download static ffmpeg (from John Van Sickle's builds)
echo "Downloading ffmpeg..."
wget -O /tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/releases/ffmpeg-release-amd64-static.tar.xz
tar -xf /tmp/ffmpeg.tar.xz -C /tmp
mv /tmp/ffmpeg-*-amd64-static/ffmpeg /deps/ffmpeg
mv /tmp/ffmpeg-*-amd64-static/ffprobe /deps/ffprobe
chmod +x /deps/ffmpeg /deps/ffprobe
rm -rf /tmp/ffmpeg*

# Download static dovi_tool
echo "Downloading dovi_tool..."
wget -O /tmp/dovi_tool.tar.gz https://github.com/quietvoid/dovi_tool/releases/download/2.1.2/dovi_tool-2.1.2-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
tar -xzf /tmp/dovi_tool.tar.gz -C /deps/
chmod +x /deps/dovi_tool
rm /tmp/dovi_tool.tar.gz

echo "All static binaries downloaded successfully!"
ls -lh /deps/

bind_address="0.0.0.0"
listen_port=8080
worker_threads=1 # or auto
redact_ip_addresses=true
result_image_theme="dark"
database_type="none"
